cases.name: the market end to end: the call, the bid, the award that binds through the claim, and the hiring integration
cases.vector: noded --agents <builder + librarian>: a roled open task is a call (capability/spec_ref/max_price derived from the task); the builder bids and a re-bid replaces its own row; the award binds the task through the ledger's own claim (a later claim is the ledger's 409); the call reads back `awarded` at the price the agent bid; the award's `escrow_entry` names the task's budget mint, which the treasury journal actually holds; and the board carries the hiring note — subject `hiring for <task>`, the template over the task's own fields, posted by the awarder

invariants.name: a roled open task is a call: capability, spec_ref and max_price derived from the task, no bids, no award
a connected agent of the call's own role bids: the row names its call, bidder and price
a re-bid replaces the agent's own row: the call still holds one bid, at the new price
the award binds the task through the ledger's own claim: claimed, assignee_id and agent_cid set
an awarded task is indistinguishable from a claimed one: claiming it again is the ledger's own 409
invariants.detail: {"error":"a task may not go from claimed to claimed"}

invariants.name: the call reads back `awarded`, with the award's row at the price the agent bid (never one the caller named)
the award's `escrow_entry` names the ledger's own escrow: the task's budget mint, which the treasury journal holds
the award posts the board's hiring note: the contract's subject, the awarder as author, the task link
invariants.detail: note={'id': 'p1', 'agent_cid': 181, 'role': 'librarian', 'subject': 'hiring for t1', 'body': "builder — the plaza's paid work (acceptance: the artifact is filed)", 'task': 't1', 'posted_by': 'librarian', 'created_at': 1791693205660}

invariants.name: the hiring note's body is the template over the task's own fields (capability — goal, and its acceptance)
invariants.detail: body="builder — the plaza's paid work (acceptance: the artifact is filed)"

cases.name: the market's refusals, the unbudgeted call's null escrow, and the bounded calls read
cases.vector: noded --agents <builder + librarian>: every bid and award refusal in the endpoint's own words (a role that is not the call's capability, a price above the ceiling, an unconnected agent, a task that is not a call, an award with no bid, an unknown task, a malformed body, the method contract); a closed call takes neither a bid nor a second award; an unbudgeted call awards with a `null` escrow entry and posts no journal entry; and the calls response is bounded at 257 calls (the newest 256, oldest first, untruncated window said so)

invariants.name: the bid and the award are POST-only
a refused bid or award changes nothing: the call still holds no bid and no award
the award closes the call and binds the task
a second award on the same call is a 409 naming the contractor it already has
invariants.detail: 409 {"error":"call t1 is already awarded to builder"}

invariants.name: a bid on a call that has closed is a 409 naming the state it is in
an unbudgeted call bids at zero and awards with a null escrow entry (there is no mint to name)
an unbudgeted call posts no journal entry (nothing was minted)
